collection.description: A child notices small shore crabs retreating before adults notice the rising water near a play area.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) notices small shore crabs retreating before adults notice the rising water near a play area.

choices.label: Listen and Move the Game Uphill
Ask the Child to Show the Signs
Check the Shoreline with an Adult
Turn It into a Nature Lesson

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: Everyone relocates before the lower sand becomes wet.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (child) is proud, but the adults explain that animal behavior is a clue, not a guaranteed forecast.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (child) points to damp sand beneath the driftwood and teaches others to notice it.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Another child spots a safer route and the group works together.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: They confirm the tide is advancing and mark a temporary play boundary.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The water remains low; the adults thank (child) for speaking up anyway.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: Children make a tide diary with adult help.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The group learns that different crabs respond differently, complicating their first theory.
